# ClosedLoopNeuromodulation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A system architecture where neural signals are continuously sensed, processed by a neuromorphic network, and used to trigger or modulate stimulation in real time. Enables personalized and responsive therapy, but demands ultra-low-power, event-driven processing that aligns with spiking neural network implementations.
